findings.title: Invalid value for raft_first_layer_expansion
findings.explanation: This file likely carries settings from another printer or a stale profile (often a MakerWorld/Bambu-style project). The model may be fine; the project settings are the problem.
findings.suggested_action: Import the model into a clean Snapmaker U1 project instead of opening the foreign 3MF as the active project.

findings.title: Studio cannot prepare a U1 copy of this project yet
findings.explanation: Snapmaker Orca 2.4.0 cannot load this project: part 1 of object 2 ("slab.stl") (inner_wall_speed, outer_wall_speed) has values it cannot read (a blank 'nil' entry), and Orca stops loading the whole file when it meets one. Studio does not edit those values for you. Open the original in the slicer that made it, reset those part settings, and export it again.
findings.suggested_action: Open the original in Snapmaker Orca to review it, or remove the unverified settings in the slicer that made it and export it again.
findings.evidence: 1 item(s) Studio has not verified Snapmaker Orca reads

findings.title: Relative extrusion without a per-layer reset
findings.explanation: Your profile uses relative extrusion but may not reset the extruder position each layer. Newer Orca/Snorca versions are stricter about this.
findings.suggested_action: Switch back to the official Snapmaker U1 profile (or reset the profile). Only add G92 E0 to the layer-change g-code if you understand the setting.
findings.evidence: use_relative_e_distances is enabled; no 'G92 E0' found in layer-change g-code

findings.title: Object spacing / collisions are not verified by Studio yet
findings.explanation: Studio does not yet check object-to-object spacing for multi-part 3MF layouts, so it cannot confirm objects aren't too close or colliding.
findings.suggested_action: Open in Snapmaker Orca and check for too-close / collision warnings; use Arrange or move objects before slicing.
findings.evidence: 2 object(s) on the plate; spacing unchecked by Studio

nil_speeds.recommendation: Prefer importing the model into a clean Snapmaker U1 project rather than opening this foreign 3MF as the active project. Studio diagnoses these issues read-only; it does not change your file.
